EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our Accept & Pay webinar! Catch up now.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We’re sorry to have missed you at our webinar “Accept & Pay: Reduce turnaround times and increase transparency by streamlining the acceptance and payment process.” ‌ In this webinar, we discussed:
- Current problems facing institutions and agents during the acceptance and payment stage of the student journey. - The business benefits and results institutions and agents can achieve with a powerful and integrated admissions and payment process. - The Accept & Pay solution and its standout features.
Watch the recording here <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-accept-and-pay-solution]]>.
Need more information about Accept & Pay or have questions? Please reach out to your Relationship Manager, or email learnmore@flywire.com <[[mailto:learnmore@flywire.com]]> or explore the Accept & Pay Data Sheet <[[https://assets.flywire.com/collateral/education/clients/Flywire_EDU_DataSheet_AcceptandPay.pdf]]>.
Thank you! The Flywire and StudyLink Teams Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
